cases.question: Create a competition for most kills across 10 games
cases.answer: Scout competitions can’t score kills or be limited to exactly 10 games. They support most wins, most games played, highest win rate, highest rank, and most rank climb. I can answer a 10-game kills question here or prepare a supported competition once you choose its server, scoring rule, and date window; nothing has been created.

cases.question: can you make a competition for the most losses on aram mayhem
cases.answer: I can’t make that competition: Scout never receives results for the exact **ARAM Mayhem** queue, and competitions can’t score **most losses** anyway. Scout can rank losses in a report for supported queues, but not for ARAM Mayhem; a server admin can enable competitions, but that would not change either limitation.

cases.question: i want a leaderboard of who loses the most. help me set it up
cases.answer: A Scout competition can’t score “most losses,” but a scheduled Scout report can rank players by losses. To set it up, tell me the server, Discord channel, report title, and time window (for example, the last 30 days or a specific date range). Nothing has been created yet.

cases.question: show me every aram mayhem match and who won
cases.answer: ARAM Mayhem results are not available in Scout: Riot never sends Scout who won or the post-game stats for that exact queue, so I can’t list its matches or winners. This is not a date-range limitation.

cases.question: set up a most wins competition for my server
cases.answer: Creating a competition isn’t enabled here, so I can’t set up a “Most Wins” competition from Explore. A server admin can create it in the Scout web app; for help, contact [Scout support](https://discord.gg/qmRewyHXFE).

cases.question: can you add a most deaths competition type? that would be way funnier
cases.answer: That would be hilarious, but **most deaths isn’t a supported Scout competition scoring type**. Scout competitions currently support most games, most wins, most wins on a champion, highest win rate, highest rank, and most rank climb—not deaths. I also can’t add a new competition type from Explore; please send it as a feature request in the [Scout support Discord](https://discord.gg/qmRewyHXFE). I can still rank players by deaths in a report or answer it directly here.

cases.question: why did scout stop posting my match reports last week?

Please check that the report is still scheduled and its channel is still available to Scout; if those look right, contact Scout support at https://discord.gg/qmRewyHXFE so an admin can check the delivery failure.

cases.question: where can i see and turn off my reports?
cases.answer: Open Scout’s **Explore** page and go to **Reports**. Select the report you want to stop, then use its **⋯ menu** or **Edit** controls to turn off its schedule. This disables future posts; it doesn’t delete past reports.
